description: A decommissioned industrial unit with the roller door cut out and replaced by plate glass, so what the road sees is a lit showroom floor sitting inside a shell that still has the old crane rail bolted across its ceiling. Two armchairs and a standard lamp are staged on a rug out on the forecourt, in the weather, angled at the traffic like somebody's front room got evicted. Nobody has taken them. The door is west; the road runs east.
name: Dead Space Interiors
